outcome: Incidence of vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2
cohort: 48 SARS-CoV-2-positive asymptomatic women admitted for delivery
finding: Vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 was confirmed in only one out of 48 cases, suggesting a low transmission rate in asymptomatic mothers.
mod_finding: Out of 48 SARS-CoV-2 positive mothers, 28 (58.3%) delivered via cesarean section.
